{{Quote|It's the Voidwolf! Aaaaah!|Rowost|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Rowost''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Officer/Legends|Flight Officer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]], he was part of the escort that accompanied a Republic Senator and [[Darmas Pollaran]] to ''[[Port Nowhere]]'' alongside [[Kuthana]], [[Matto]], and [[Presk]] when ''Port Nowhere'' came under attack by an Imperial fleet led by the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]].
